an3.183-352:4.3:
niṭṭhitaṃ → tassuddānaṃ : pāṇaṃ adinnamicchā ca musāvādī ca pisuṇā 
pharusā samphappalāpo ca abhijjhāvyāpāde diṭṭhi ca 
kammapathesu peyyālaṃ tikakena niyojaye ti. – machasaṃ.

(kammapathapeyyāle vīsati kammapathasuttāni daṭṭhabbāni. potthekasu akusalaṃ kusala kammapathavasena ekato yojitāni daseva suttāni peyyālamukhehi dissanti. rāga pyolamukhehi sattatyadhikasuttāni daṭṭhabbāni)
an3.183-352:6.3: pabhassarā → pabhassaro (sabbattha) | manasi → āsevabhāvamanasā (sabbattha) | tā → sabbavatthitā (sabbattha) | ciṇṇapaññattapañcamaṃ → paṇṇattipañcamaṃ (sabbattha) | sambudhā → sampadā (sabbattha) | saṃ → yañcassaṃ (sabbattha) | paññācariyena → viññācariyena (sabbattha)
an3.183-352:8.2: nirayā → niraye (sabbattha) | tiracchānayoniyā → tiracchānayoniyo (sabbattha) | uṭṭhānaṃ → upaṭṭhānaṃ (sabbattha) | balabojjhaṅgā → bojjhaṅgo (sabbattha) | mahāputhuvipulañca → vepullañca (sabbattha) | hāsu → āsu (sabbattha) | bhuñjantibhuttaparihīnaṃ → parihīnattā (sabbattha) | caraṇakaccānacorā → galitabyañjanā pane‘tā gāthā viranikkittā dissanti. | duttappapaccayañca → galitabyañjanā pane‘tā gāthā viranikkittā dissanti. | ca → galitabyañjanā pane‘tā gāthā viranikkittā dissanti.
an3.183-352:8.4: sārāṇīyo → ñāto bhāraṇīyo bhikkhu (machasaṃ) | devo → deva (sīmu)
an3.183-352:8.5: kāyasakkhi → samiddha (machasaṃ); saviṭṭha (syā, kām) | arūko → vajirena ca (machasaṃ) | pupphabhāṇī → guthabhāṇi (machasaṃ) | sammukhiṭṭhānatthakathāpavattanī → paresa vattanī (sīmu) | jiṇṇā → janā (sīmu); janā brāhmaṇaññatarena (machasaṃ)
an3.183-352:8.6: vaggoti → porāṇehi tāni tāni suttāni uddāna gāthāsu saññūḷhāni. kiñcāpi tā gāthāyo sugītā sunikkhittā. tathāpi, etarahi viluttapāṭhā vikiṇṇapāṭhā dissanti. teneva, kammapathapeyyālādisupi āgatāni suttāni nābhisambhūṇāma. atthikehi mantāya upaññātabbāni.
